title: Safety Policies (/policies)
description: The governance brain. Visual rule builder as DEFAULT (Cloudflare WAF style). Monaco YAML as advanced toggle. Policy simulator, publish/rollback, analytics.
architectureNotes: Visual rule builder is the PRIMARY interface — rules read like sentences. Monaco editor (@monaco-editor/react) for YAML toggle. Bidirectional: visual ↔ YAML round-trips on same data model. Simulator at /api/v1/policy/simulate. Conflict detection for rule priority. Recharts for policy analytics.
